title: Good to know: case-opening
before: A social worker can talk with your child at school without a court order. They must tell you afterward.
after: A social worker can talk with your child at school without a court order, as long as no police officer is there. They must tell you afterward.

title: Good to know: eighteen-month
before: If you are 16 or older, you should have a plan for adult life covering school, work, housing, and money.
after: If you are 16 or older, you should have a written plan for adult life. Ask to see it.
note: Dropped the list of what the plan covers.

title: Good to know: review-hearings
before: At 16, planning for adult life starts: school, work, housing, and money.

title: Dashboard What matters: eighteen-month
before: Complete every remaining case plan requirement — this is the deadline
after: Finish everything left on your case plan. For most parents this is the last deadline. Ask your lawyer if more time is possible for you.

title: Foster care intro
before: to visit your child regularly
after: to ask for visits with your child (the judge sets them and can limit them if they are not safe)

title: Foster care intro
before: Parenting classes, housing assistance, mental health support, and substance use treatment are often available at no cost.
after: Your case plan may include parenting classes, counseling and treatment. Ask your social worker which ones are free.

title: Foster care intro
before: Parenting classes, housing assistance, mental health support, and legal aid are often available at low or no cost.
after: There are parenting classes, counseling and other help. Ask the social worker or the lawyer which ones are free.

title: Onboarding
before: If you do not have one yet, the court will appoint one.
after: If you cannot pay, ask the judge at your first hearing. The judge will give you one.

title: Onboarding
before: Your answers are private and never shared with CPS or the court.
after: Your answers are private. We do not share them with CPS or the court.
note: The word "never" still needs a check against the privacy policy.

title: Under 13 page
before: There is also a free state office that helps kids in foster care when something is wrong. It is called the Foster Care Ombudsperson. You can call them.
after: There is also a state office that helps kids in foster care when something is wrong. It is called the Foster Care Ombudsperson. You can call them. The call is free.
note: Put "The call is free." at the end of the paragraph so it reads cleanly.
